premise.claim: Container-level hooks cannot coordinate update preparation, recovery, post-ready application registration, and safe deletion across an entire (multi-Pod) inference instance; RBG's existing RIS lifecycle needs extension to instance-level hooks across RI create/update/ready/delete.
premise.evidence: Issue #527 is OPEN and matches the KEP's component and motivation. Codebase-truth checks 1-10 all pass on the PR head: the existing RIS lifecycle (preDelete/inPlaceUpdate, executor-registration labelsHandler/finalizersHandler), RoleInstanceCustomReady + readiness-gate early return, RI readinessGates, RI-owned Pods via controllerRef, no RI finalizer, no RI phase field, admission webhook infra, and the workloads.x-k8s.io/v1alpha2 group all exist/behave as the KEP describes. Scope divergence vs the issue (4 hooks proposed vs 5 requested; preCreate/postDelete dropped, preRecover added) is disclosed in the KEP's Drawbacks; PR only 'Refs #527' so no auto-close. See results/check-kep527-head-6e8419ab.tsv.
